Players Committee card image of [[Jango Fett (ALT)]] (original printing), game text: “Adds 2 to power and 1 to maneuver of anything he pilots. Adds one battle destiny with opponent's Jedi, [Maintenance] card, or [Permanent Weapon] card. May be targeted by Hidden Weapons, If about to be lost, may take Boba Fett into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle.”

Source: <code>Images-HT/starwars/VirtualAlternateImage-Dark/large/jangofett_ai.png</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable image repository, version of commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/91ca80c51880e683322c125b7a0b6ec807df1ab8 91ca80c] (18 February 2021). The PC serves its card images from this repository at res.starwarsccg.org; this is an earlier version of that file.

Edits: none. The repository's bytes are uploaded unchanged (the repository file is named .gif but is PNG data, so it is uploaded with a .png name).

== Preservation ==
Wayback copy of this exact original (SHA-256 verified by the central preservation owner): [https://web.archive.org/web/20261127031337/https://swccg.com/wiki/images/f/fb/V1-D-jangofett_ai-2021-02-18.png Internet Archive].
